examples.title: Source-time Mapping
examples.summary: Compare linear trims, a speed ramp, a freeze frame, fast-forward playback, and explicit source-boundary holds.

checks.expect: The reel advances continuously from source time 5s to 8s at normal speed.
Motion accelerates as source time advances from 10s to 15s.
One frame holds for two seconds, then the reel plays at 2x speed.
The nested source holds its first frame before the range and its last frame after it.

examples.title: Transforms & Keyframes
examples.summary: Animate a rounded graphic through typed position interpolation while retaining rotation, opacity, and placement.

checks.expect: The teal rounded block moves through several easing phases before settling.
The block remains in the lower-right area with a slight rotation and 90% opacity.
The position curve retains hold, linear, easing, and cubic-bezier segments.

examples.title: Blend Modes
examples.summary: Compare all twelve compositing modes over one dark-blue base.

checks.expect: Each one-second segment produces a distinct brightening, darkening, or contrast mix.
Channel selection and dodge visibly change the flat overlay colors.

checks.cue: 6-9s - Color burn, hard light, soft light
checks.expect: The three contrast families remain visually distinct.
Difference and exclusion alter the relationship before the normal reference segment.

examples.title: Masks & Track Mattes
examples.summary: Combine geometric masks with luma and inverted-alpha track mattes in the entry sequence.

checks.expect: Pink content is constrained by the intersecting geometric masks.
The radial matte produces a soft center-to-edge attenuation.
The blue consumer remains around the transparent portion of the inverted radial alpha matte.
The entry sequence owns both luma and inverted-alpha matte relations.

examples.title: Apply Scopes
examples.summary: Apply ordered pipelines to a composite band, one layer, and an exact item set.

checks.expect: Contrast, blur, and a circular mix affect the composed band.
Only the overlay layer receives the brightness adjustment.
The selected item group receives contrast and multiply composition.
Each apply block preserves its authored pipeline order and scope.

examples.title: Video Effect Stack
examples.summary: Run a gradient through animated blur and an ordered sharpen, color, vignette, grain, and keying stack.

checks.expect: The image moves from visibly blurred toward a sharper result.
Sharpening, color adjustment, vignette, and grain remain visible without flicker.
All eight registry-backed effects retain their authored order and typed parameters.

examples.title: Audio Processing & Routing
examples.summary: Compare gain automation, pitch policies, fade curves, EQ and dynamics, normalization, buses, and sidechain routing.

checks.expect: Level rises from -12 dB to -2 dB while 2x playback preserves pitch and uses equal-power fades.
The faster source follows playback pitch and passes through a gate with linear fades.
The segment uses the -16 LUFS processor with exponential fades.
The final segment applies the registry-backed -18 LUFS normalization effect.
Bus routing, sidechain relation, compressor, and source mappings remain explicit.

examples.title: Text Layout
examples.summary: Show a bounded horizontal paragraph plus both vertical writing directions.

checks.expect: The paragraph wraps inside its box with background, outline, and styled spans.
VEAC is arranged vertically from right to left.
LEFT is arranged vertically from left to right.
All text remains inside its declared layout boxes without clipping.

examples.title: Text Animation Units
examples.summary: Sequence visible reveals by whole block, line, word, and grapheme units.

checks.expect: The complete block fades, slides, scales, and highlights as one unit.
The two lines reveal independently with a stagger.
Words reveal one after another rather than as one block.
Characters appear progressively with the typewriter-style stagger.

examples.title: Advanced Color & LUTs
examples.summary: Compare an ordered primary grade plus 3D LUT with a separate 1D tone-curve LUT.

checks.expect: The gray-blue field passes through HSL, luma curves, color wheels, and the cinematic 3D LUT.
The same source switches to the one-dimensional tone-curve LUT.
The grade changes cleanly at the cut without a gap.
Basic, matrix, HSL, curves, wheels, and LUT stages retain authoring order.

examples.title: Generated Graphics
examples.summary: Sequence transparent, solid, gradient, shape, fill, and stroke generators.

checks.expect: A blank frame is followed by a full teal field.
A radial multi-stop gradient is followed by a rounded rectangle with fill and stroke.
A filled triangle is followed by a path drawn with a radial-gradient stroke.
A teal ellipse and blue rectangle complete the geometry set; audio stays silent.

examples.title: Transition Gallery
examples.summary: Compare dissolve, fade, wipe, slide, zoom, circle, and pixelize transitions in sequence.

checks.expect: The first cut cross-dissolves; the second passes through black.
A leftward wipe is followed by an upward slide.
The next cuts zoom inward and open through a soft circle.
The final cut resolves through coarse pixel blocks.

examples.title: Delivery Formats
examples.summary: Deliver one timeline as video, PNG frames, WebVTT, a WAV stem, and a waveform image.

checks.expect: The three-second H.264/AAC master contains the burned-in caption.
The image-sequence output contains one PNG for every preview frame.
The WebVTT artifact contains the 0-3s delivery cue.
The 48 kHz stereo master stem spans the complete timeline.
The waveform scope is a non-empty 1280x720 image.

examples.title: Minimal Project
examples.summary: Render the smallest typed project as a three-second navy canvas.

checks.expect: The frame remains a uniform navy color for the complete output.
There are no cuts, overlays, or unexpected audio.
The project contains only main sequence, visual layer, and background item.

examples.title: Hello, VEAC
examples.summary: Render centered text over a vertical dark gradient with the basic typed text source.

checks.expect: The canvas holds a smooth teal-to-near-black vertical gradient.
Hello, VEAC stays centered, white, and fully inside its text box.
Separate background and title layers preserve their visual order.

examples.title: Cross-mechanism Integration
examples.summary: Combine media trim, color, graphics, audio processing, captions, and AV relations in one delivery.

checks.expect: The fixture footage is visible beneath the color grade and burned-in caption.
A deep-blue translucent overlay enters at one second and remains above the picture.
The caption remains readable while the processed music bed is audible.
The project produces one H.264/AAC MP4 and retains group plus AV-link relations in IR.

examples.title: AgentsMesh Intro
examples.summary: Preview a complete 15-second brand title, promise, and caption sequence.

checks.expect: AgentsMesh is centered in white over a stable blue-green diagonal gradient.
The supporting promise appears below the brand and remains fully readable.
The bottom caption stays inside its padded semi-transparent panel.
The brand retains grapheme granularity, stagger, and typed transform animation.

examples.title: Captions & Sidecars
examples.summary: Burn in two speaker-tagged timeline captions and export the same layer as WebVTT.

checks.expect: Captions are timeline sources appears with a translucent black background.
Sidecars select typed caption layers replaces the opening cue.
Two Narrator cues span 0-3s and 3-6s.
The sidecar output selects only the subtitles caption layer.

examples.title: Rounded Card Overlay
examples.summary: Place a translucent rounded card at an absolute position over a dark gradient.

checks.expect: The card stays at x=280, y=170 with a 720x380 frame.
The off-white panel remains translucent at 92% opacity.
A 3 px teal stroke follows the 18 px rounded corners without clipping.

examples.title: Basic Color Grade
examples.summary: Apply exposure, temperature, tint, highlight, shadow, and fade adjustments to a slate gradient.

checks.expect: The horizontal slate gradient remains continuous and appears warmer with lifted shadows.
The grade holds for the full clip without cuts or flicker.
BT.709 input and output surround a linear-RGB working stage with all six controls.

examples.title: Executable Mechanisms & Annotations
examples.summary: Combine a transition, animated graphic, blend and mask modifiers, and nine typed analysis annotations.

checks.expect: The warm gradient dissolves into the cool gradient around the one-second cut.
A green ellipse moves horizontally while screen-blended through a circular mask.
Marker, language, scene boundary, scene, beat, silence, filler, highlight, and review are all present.
The authored media ends cleanly at two seconds.

examples.title: Image Overlay
examples.summary: Anchor an image at bottom right with contain sizing, scaling, opacity, and screen blending.

checks.expect: The image stays 48 px from the right and bottom edges.
The asset fits a 320x320 frame and is then scaled to 35%.
The image remains at 90% opacity with screen blending over the navy background.

examples.title: Nested Sequence & Multicam
examples.summary: Play a nested opener, then switch a typed multicam program from host to guest.

checks.expect: The cyan slate is rendered from the intro sequence.
The program begins on the first motion fixture.
The program cuts to the visibly different second fixture at clip-local two seconds.
Audio sync, both angles, and the 120 ms guest offset remain explicit.

examples.title: Fast & Slow Motion
examples.summary: Play one source first at 2x speed and then at 0.5x speed.

checks.expect: Four seconds of source motion are compressed into two seconds.
The next source range advances at half speed for the complete segment.
Motion visibly changes from fast to slow without a gap.
Both segments retain exact linear source ranges and record durations.

examples.title: Typed Template Slots
examples.summary: Declare replaceable media and text slots over visible placeholder content.

checks.expect: The placeholder video renders beneath the white Replaceable title text.
The hero slot accepts video, uses fit-duration, and requires at least two seconds of source.
The title item owns a typed text slot.
The preview is the unfilled template; no applied binding is implied.

examples.title: Styled Text Overlay
examples.summary: Render centered text with a background, outline, and shadow over a navy canvas.

checks.expect: The white bold title remains centered and fully readable.
A 2 px cyan outline and padded translucent-black background surround the text.
A soft black shadow remains offset down and right.
The title stays within its declared box without clipping.

examples.title: Basic Dissolve
examples.summary: Dissolve between two solid-color scenes across a 400 ms centered cut.

checks.expect: The frame remains solid red before the transition.
Red and blue cross-fade smoothly across the cut.
The frame settles to solid blue.
The transition keeps first-to-second endpoints, centered alignment, and 400 ms duration.
